objective: Harden the existing application for a COD production deployment with manual billing and verified domains
acceptance_criteria: Production rejects unsafe configuration and does not seed demo accounts or create tables at startup
Tenant roles, moderation, subscription expiry, domains and tracking enforce authorization
Checkout uses server totals, atomic stock updates and idempotent retries; cancellation cannot inflate stock
Billing requires administrator payment verification and custom domains require DNS ownership verification
Frontend callers reflect real payment/domain/order behavior and use supported dependencies
Versioned migrations, deployment configuration, backup/restore instructions and CI are provided
Regression tests, frontend types/build, migration checks and dependency checks have recorded results
non_goals: Executing migrations on existing user databases
